source.notes: main (base, and control: main extracted a second time) is the table pipeline of ADR-191, whose span asks the worker for the hit index; the working tree's span asks for none. rows by sample is a million synthetic features split into 26 rows and drawn as spans; the MAF row is marks_maf_cells over the synthetic MAF-tabix fixture at 470 species, 5.5M runs. Interleaved round-robin with the order rotated, MIN across rounds, lanes other than the index checked equal before timing. The row index a hover builds on the main thread is not in these times: at 5.5M runs rowSpanIndex took 169 ms where the Flatbush took 1390 ms, measured apart.
